parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid value:

- **DOMAIN**: domain name

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: An array of tag key-value pairs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. The key cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun` and cannot be longer than 20 bytes.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. The value cannot be longer than 20 bytes.
